risk_analysis.risk_fix_a: Overzealous regex could strip legitimate content mentioning 'AI' or 'language model' as part of technical discussion. Mitigation: sentence-boundary matching (require phrase to be followed by [.!?]) and specific denial verb pairing (I am/I cannot/I don't have/soy/no tengo).
risk_analysis.risk_fix_b: Widening interrogative patterns could shift some prompts currently classified as unknown_or_insufficient_info toward brain_self_knowledge_lookup, potentially triggering evidence tool scheduling on ambiguous queries. Mitigation: added patterns are multi-word specific phrases, not single-word verbs.
risk_analysis.risk_fix_c: Additional multi-word patterns could theoretically match some non-write queries, but all patterns are explicit promotion/commit/consolidation verbs specific to memory-write intent. Low risk.
risk_analysis.risk_fix_d: New helper method must handle absence of tool_results gracefully. Mitigation: pure defaults path when state has no tool_results; no external I/O.
risk_analysis.no_regression_protection: Existing 10 tests from previous front's test file must still pass; regression suite must pass
